meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

copy.tagline: 先制定决策完备的开发计划，再动手写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次动手开发前都想先把计划想清楚
copy.tagline_en: Map out an actionable work plan before you start coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear plan ready before touching code

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求制定工作计划时，Claude会先查看项目代码，只问几个必要问题，等你说“可以”后，写出一份详细到可直接执行的工作计划；它自己不会动手写代码。
howto.when: 当你明确说出 ulw-plan、ulw plan 等关键词，或用自己话要求编码前先做计划时触发；它不会自动激活。

say.text: 先别写码，用 ulw-plan 给我做个开发计划
say.note: Claude会进入规划模式，先探索项目再问你要不要批准

say.text: plan before coding，帮我把这个需求拆成步骤
say.note: 它会先探索代码，再请求批准写计划

say.text: make a plan for 登录功能
say.note: 它会研究相关代码，然后给你一份计划征求同意

howto.what_en: When active, Claude acts as a planning consultant: it explores the codebase read-only, asks only essential questions, waits for your explicit approval, then writes one detailed, decision-complete work plan for a downstream executor. It never edits product code or implements anything.
howto.when_en: When you explicitly request the ulw-plan workflow, e.g. saying "ulw-plan", "ulw plan", "/skill:ulw-plan", or asking in your own words for a work plan before coding. It never self-activates.

say_en.text: Don't code yet, use ulw-plan to make a dev plan.
say_en.note: Claude enters plan mode, explores, then asks approval.

say_en.text: Plan before coding, break this requirement into steps.
say_en.note: It explores read-only, then requests approval.

say_en.text: Make a plan for the login feature.
say_en.note: It researches code, then offers a plan for approval.
